motives.rhyme: The last of the pie, gone in the blink of an eye
Cut off in commute, when in bumper to boot
The day we wed, forgotten and dead
A sneeze set free, for all to see
Provisions, though light, are nowhere in sight
No roll for the next soul
The dairy air, without a care
A favorite top, left with a spot
A gadget made loud, in the middle of a crowd
A message read, then left for dead
A meal on view, with every chew
To reach 100% the cord was taken without consent
The seat of the bowl, left up like a fool
The King's English, spoken in anguish
The ending told, before it could unfold
Felt ignored by an unheld door
A cart left stray, in the carriage way
A message sent to the mass, replied to all like an ass
